svg.title: Reduce unnecessary interaction work
svg.desc: An opportunity hypothesis map keeps three alternative mechanisms and disconfirming tests separate.

g.text: Reduce unnecessary interaction work
O1
Make the function easier to find
Mechanism: remove a verified navigation detour.
Retain the information needed for a decision.
Test: same task / same choices / different path.
Reject if the current shortcut already works.
O2
Make known and unknown state clear
Mechanism: truthful feedback and recovery.
A captured input is not confirmed completion.
Test: pending / failed / unknown interpretations.
Reject labels that imply an unsupported result.
O3
Let useful unfinished work be left
Mechanism: deliberate review and return.
A restored draft never applies itself.
Test: compare against competent persistence.
Reject the layer if it adds work without value.
NOV 2026 · NEW ANALYSIS / NOT A PARTICIPANT TEST
